label: Todo
note: The race flagship: per-user rows, optimistic where the stack has it.

canary.sql: update todos set title = $1 where id = (select id from todos where user_id = 'bench-user' order by created_at, id limit 1)

nav.canary: update todos set title = $1 where id = (select id from todos where user_id = 'bench-user' and not done order by created_at, id limit 1)

rows.50: delete from todos where user_id = 'bench-user' and created_at > timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:50:00+00'
rows.500: insert into todos (user_id, title, created_at) select 'bench-user', 'Extra todo ' || g, timestamptz '2026-10-02 00:00:00+00' + (g * interval '1 minute') from generate_series(1, 300) g

race.state: select title, done from todos where user_id = 'bench-user'
